calls.statement:
SELECT cs.format AS cur_format, s.format AS ver_format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT (s.store_id, f.receipt_id)) AS receipts_store,
       COUNT(DISTINCT (s.store_id, f.sale_date, f.receipt_id)) AS receipts_store_date,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id),2) AS atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, s.store_id, f.sale_date, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.category, f.net_amount, f.quantity, f.channel_code
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND s.store_id<900)
SELECT 'mixed_staff_receipts' AS chk, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS v FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff_receipts', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS VARCHAR) FROM l WHERE staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'test_lines_in_nonstaff', CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM l WHERE category='ZZ Test' AND NOT staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'store999_lines', CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM l WHERE store_id=999
UNION ALL SELECT 'nonpositive_net_lines', CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM l WHERE net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'channel_'||COALESCE(channel_code,'null'), CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM l GROUP BY channel_code
UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt_receipts_P4_all_stores', CAST(SUM(receipts) AS VARCHAR) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND r.store_id<900
UNION ALL SELECT 'ours_receipts_all_incl_staff_excl_999', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS VARCHAR) FROM l WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test'
